response.sql: WITH tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_p FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS o FROM signals), kept1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_p FROM tel t, overall o WHERE t.avg_p > o.o), second AS (SELECT AVG(avg_p) AS s FROM kept1), kept2 AS (SELECT k.telescref, k.avg_p FROM kept1 k, second s WHERE k.avg_p > s.s) SELECT AVG(k.avg_p) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(k.avg_p - o.o) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(k.avg_p - s.s) AS avg_above_second FROM kept2 k, overall o, second s
